checks.name: raw image hashes distinct across included cohort

interpretation_limits: Hash matches verify current published bytes and recorded original-identifier consistency, not absent payload bytes or authenticity of runtime claims.
Baseline original evaluation is absent; arithmetic starts from hash-bound published diagnostic counts.
Baseline/new reference class totals agree for every patient/frame/class, but equal totals cannot prove identical masks.
Patient counts are units of descriptive pairing; no pixel-IID intervals or tests.
No raw geometry recovery verification, no checkpoint replay, no TEST scoring, no statistical or causal claim.

precision_comparisons.limits: Conditional on jointly retained prediction support; not full-cohort precision, RV precision, matched pixel support, causal effect or generalization evidence.

scope: VAL saved-count arithmetic and text provenance only; no image, mask, weight or prediction arrays read; no TEST scores; no inference or training
